themes: The family of Imran and Maryam
summary_for_children: Ali 'Imran tells of the family of Imran, of Maryam and the provision she found, and of Zakariyya's prayer. It asks believers to hold together and to reflect on the night and the day.
world_title: The Sanctuary of the Family of Imran
environment_concept: A sanctuary in morning light: a small chamber with fruit in a lit niche, no one shown (3:37), a courtyard of pillars bound by one rope (3:103), a rooftop where a sundial marks the turning of night and day (3:190) and a distant gateway (3:96).
architecture_and_scenery: Stone prayer chamber, cloistered courtyard, olive garden, and a rooftop open to the sky.

areas.name: The Prayer Chamber
areas.description: A small chamber where fruit appears in a lit niche; no person is shown.

areas.name: Courtyard of the Rope
areas.description: A courtyard where a single rope binds many pillars together.

areas.name: Rooftop of Night and Day
areas.anchor_phrase: alternation of the night and the day
areas.description: A rooftop where time-lapse sky shows night and day turning.

areas.name: Gate to Bakkah
areas.description: A distant gateway marked only by its ayah.

activities.name: Hold the rope together
activities.description: Carry four stones to the circle so the pillars stand together.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Watch night turn to day
activities.description: Speed the sky from night to day and read the ayahs about reflection.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator tells the family's account in short scenes heard, not seen, and reads 3:190-191 on the rooftop.
learning_objectives: Retell Maryam's provision in the prayer chamber
Explain holding firmly to the rope of Allah
Practise reflecting on night and day

ayah_environment_connections.anchor_phrase: alternation of the night and the day

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (arch, chamber, rope, sundial) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Sanctuary of Maryam
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: Exploration by returning and waiting: come back into the prayer chamber again and again to see what has changed, walk a passage of ayahs in order, and climb a windy mountain by keeping still in the gusts.

unique_world.visual_theme: Dusk stone sanctuary courtyard, then a windy mountain path

primary_mechanic.text: Come back to the sanctuary niche three times and find it provided for (3:37, adaptation), then climb a path where gusts push you back unless you wait.

environment_behaviour: provision appears at the niche on each return (labelled adaptation)
